verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents and runs an official MCP server (jitsu.com/docs/mcp) letting AI agents manage pipelines — create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events, edit Functions — with both browser OAuth and API-key auth flows for headless use. A runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live and enforces OAuth (401 with WWW-Authenticate), corroborating the documented capability. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on review of the MCP integration beyond vendor docs/probe.
